title: ValidationSummary
description: A table2asn run, as recorded in the package.

copies.description: Hashes of the `.sqn` and `.gbf` copied into `genbank/`.

directory.description: Package-relative folder with the raw reports.

status.description:
`passed` (completed, a report was read and it has no errors),
`errors`, `unavailable` (the tool could not run: nothing is known
about the sequences) or `failed`.

Issue.description:
A finding, tied to the record (and specimen) it concerns when it
concerns one.

code.description: A stable code: Basecraft's, or the tool's (`SEQ_INST.TerminalNs`).

source.description: `basecraft` for local checks; `table2asn` for its reports.

tool_severity.description: The tool's own severity word, when it reported one.

Severity.description:
How serious a finding is. Blocking issues keep a package from being
ready; review issues need a look but don't block; unavailable means a
check could not run, which says nothing about the sequences.
